name: Isekai Itte Massage de Ikinokorou to Shitara Bikyaku Bijo to Icha x2 Life ~Ten'i Bonus ga Oishii Sugita Ken~
original_name: 異世界行ってマッサージで生き残ろうとしたら美脚美女とイチャ×2ライフ ～転移ボーナスが美味しすぎた件～
source:
After accidentally ending up in another world, the protagonist finds himself in a small village.  
Using his “transfer bonus” massage skills, he plans to savor the beautiful legs and bodies of heroines from various races—elves, demons, beastfolk, and more.  
Even mob characters get their own H-scenes!  

The protagonist, Shougo Takemine (name changeable), had been living a life of forced labor at his grandfather’s secluded mountain estate.  
But one day, on his way home, he somehow ends up in another world…  

In this world, unlike the real one, he gains the ability to sense “flows” through massage.  
Thanks to his daily routine of caring for animals and giving massages back home, he discovers that the life energy in this world is far stronger than in his previous one, thanks to the existence of magic and other supernatural forces.  
As a result, his massages have an extraordinary effect—even a simple massage can intensely energize the body, making it hot, flushed, and hypersensitive.  

In this world of diverse races and stunning beauties, he plans to work his way into their hearts… and more.  

[Translated from [url=http://www.crossover-soft.jp/crs017.php#STORY]the official website[/url]]
